title: Implementation-Backed Workflow Reconstruction
mission: Reconstruct the implemented access-provisioning workflow and prove every important diagram edge from exact source evidence.
domain: Access provisioning with normal approval, high-risk security review, provisioning failure, rollback ownership, and a conflicting progress display.
outcome: A document-led attempt is compared with three source-backed Mermaid diagrams whose states, actors, transitions, contradictions, and hashes are independently verifiable.
seededDefects: The legacy description omits the high-risk security route.
The legacy description invents an automatic provisioning retry.
The UI marks security review complete on a path that never entered it.
verificationGates: Required states, actors, routes, and conditions match protected source traces.
Every required edge maps to an exact valid source line.
A post-source workflow change is rejected before stale diagrams can pass.
Evidence hashes match the declared source SHA and diagram files.
npm run verify:exercise checks implementation quality and submission evidence.
agentWorkflow: Trace the workflow implementation and identify contradictory claims.
Create state, approval, and failure diagrams from source.
Map important edges to exact lines and compare both attempts.
Capture comparable before and after results using the conditions defined in the exercise README.
